---
title: "Table 2 - Summary of Dispensing"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(gtsummary)
require(flextable)

cdk46Data <- readRDS(here::here("data/cdk46_op_hosp_clean.RDS"))

cdk46Data|>
  mutate(year = year(year_month))|>
  rowwise()|>
  mutate(vtm = stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[1]) |>
  mutate(vmp_short_name = paste(stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[2:3], collapse=" ")) |>
  filter(year < 2025)|>
  group_by(vtm, vmp_short_name, vmp_code, year) |>
  summarise(quantity = sum(quantity)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = quantity) |>
  mutate(vmp = paste0(vmp_short_name, " (", vmp_code, ")"), .after = vtm) |>
  mutate(sort_value = as.numeric(stringr::str_split_1(vmp, "mg")[1])) |>
  ungroup()|>
  group_by(vtm)|>
  arrange(-sort_value, .by_group = T) |>
  select(-sort_value) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-vmp_short_name, -vmp_code) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(Total = sum(`2019`,`2020`,`2021`,`2022`,`2023`,`2024`, na.rm = T), .before =`2024`) |>
  as_grouped_data( groups = c("vtm"), columns = NULL)  |>
  select(-c(`2019`,`2020`,`2021`,`2022`,`2023`)) |>
  mutate(DDD = c("300mg",NA,NA,NA,"94mg",NA,NA,NA,NA,NA,NA, "450mg", NA), .before = Total) -> coreTable

cdk46Data|>
  mutate(year = year(year_month))|>
  rowwise()|>
  mutate(vtm = stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[1]) |>
  mutate(vmp_short_name = paste(stringr::str_split_1(as.character(vmp_name), " ")[2:3], collapse=" ")) |>
  filter(year < 2025)|>
  group_by(vtm, year) |>
  summarise(ddd_quantity = sum(ddd_quantity)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = ddd_quantity) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(Total = sum(`2019`,`2020`,`2021`,`2022`,`2023`,`2024`, na.rm = T), .before =`2024`) |>
  select(-c(`2019`,`2020`,`2021`,`2022`,`2023`)) -> dddTable

coreTable |>
  rows_update(dddTable, by = "vtm") |>
  mutate(vtm = case_when(
    vtm == "Abemaciclib"  ~ "Abemaciclib (774399006)",
    vtm == "Palbociclib"  ~ "Palbociclib (777047009)",
    vtm == "Ribociclib"  ~ "Ribociclib (777435007)",
    T ~ NA
  )) |>
  rename("VTM (SNOMED CT Code)" = vtm, "VMP (dm+d Code)" = vmp, "Last year" = `2024`) -> coreTable




coreTable%>%
  flextable() |>
  bold(i=c(1,5,12)) |>
  colformat_double(digits = 0) |>
  flextable::footnote(i=c(1,5,12,1,5,12), j=c(4,4,4,5,5,5), 
      value=as_paragraph(
        c("Defined daily doses")),
      ref_symbols = c("*"), 
      part = "body", inline = T) |>
  flextable::footnote(i=c(6,8,10), j=c( 2,2,2), 
      value=as_paragraph(
        c("Palbociclib capsules were phased out in January 2021")),
      ref_symbols = c("†"), 
      part = "body", inline =T) |>
  
      font (fontname = "Arial", part="all") |>
      fontsize(size=8, part = "all") |>
  hline( i = c(4,11), border =  officer::fp_border(color = "black"), part = "body") |>
  width(width=c(2.4, 5.7, 1.9,1.9,1.9) , unit="cm") -> ft

print(ft)

      
```

```{r}

save_as_rtf(ft, path = here::here("r/outputs/Table2.rtf"))

```
